title: pvExtractComponent
body:
## pvExtractComponent

Copies one component of a multi-component array (e.g. the z velocity Uz from U) into a new single-component array named OutputArrayName on the same points or cells; the dataset is otherwise unchanged. Use it when a later operation (contour, threshold) needs a scalar. calculator can do the same with an expression such as U_Z.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Component is zero-based: 0 is x, 1 is y, 2 is z.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractComponent`. Identity: `filters/ExtractComponent`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the Extract Component filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Component` | This property indicates the component of the array to be extracted. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `InputArray` | This property indicates the name of the array to be extracted. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `OutputArrayName` | This property indicates the name of the output scalar array. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractComponent",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
